name: Test

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - "main"
      - "develop"
    tags:
      - "v*"

env:
  GO_VERSION: "1.26"

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        goarch: [amd64, arm64]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y sqlite3

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          go test -v ./... -timeout 30s

      - name: Run race detector on main/develop/tags
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        run: |
          go test -v ./... -race -timeout 60s

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache: true

      - name: Check gofix drift on changed Go files
        run: |
          # Get changed Go files safely
          changed_files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}"...HEAD | grep '\.go$' || true)
          
          if [ -z "$changed_files" ]; then
            echo "No backend files to check with go fix."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Get unique package directories safely
          gopkgs=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed_files" | xargs -n 1 dirname | sort -u)
          
          tmp=$(mktemp)
          failed=0
          
          # Process each package safely
          while IFS= read -r pkg; do
            if [ -n "$pkg" ]; then
              pkg_err=$(mktemp)
              if ! go fix -diff "./$pkg" >> "$tmp" 2> "$pkg_err"; then
                if grep -Eq 'fix: .* skipped \(e\.g\. due to conflicts\)' "$pkg_err"; then
                  echo "go fix reported skipped fixes for ./$pkg; continuing."
                else
                  echo "go fix failed for ./$pkg:"
                  cat "$pkg_err"
                  failed=1
                fi
              fi
              rm -f "$pkg_err"
            fi
          done <<< "$gopkgs"

          if [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ -s "$tmp" ]; then
            echo "go fix would make changes to the following files:"
            cat "$tmp"
            echo "Please run 'go fix ./...' to apply these changes."
            exit 1
          fi
          rm -f "$tmp"

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: latest
          args: --timeout=5m

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, lint]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache: true

      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          go build -o qui ./cmd/qui

      - name: Upload binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: qui-binary
          path: qui
          retention-days: 1
